title: Prime Minister shares an article on how India's solar energy journey is opening up new opportunities
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi,  today, shared an article by Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi, on how India’s solar energy journey is opening up new opportunities. Shri Modi remarked that the  article highlights the growth of solar power in India, driven by initiatives such as PM Surya Ghar and PM-KUSUM. “He also looks at what lies ahead, from solar-powered agriculture and energy storage to manufacturing and green jobs, as India works towards its 500 GW renewable energy target”, Shri Modi added. Shri Modi posted on X; India's solar energy journey is opening up new opportunities!
